description: Connect your Refiner account to analyze survey responses with ChatGPT. Uncover trends and emerging topics, summarize feedback from NPS, CSAT, and other in-app surveys using natural language. Ask questions about your survey results, identify key drivers of satisfaction, and quickly surface patterns in qualitative feedback to better understand your users and improve your product.

defaultPrompt: What are top drivers behind our CSAT score?
Summarize open-text responses and highlight verbatim mentioning UX issues
